```{python}
#| label: cargar-corpus
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path.cwd().parent if Path.cwd().name == "docs" else Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "docs" / "study"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import render_helpers as rh
from report_helpers import kpis

idx = rh.corpus_index(); caps = rh.corpus_captions(); titles = rh.corpus_titles()
kpis([
    (str(len(idx["article_figures"]) + len(idx["figures"])), "Plates (5 of the corpus article and 54 supplementary), 1000 px JPG previews"),
    (str(len(idx["article_tables"]) + len(idx["tables"])), "Tables (7 of the article and 125 supplementary), presentation CSVs"),
    ("18", "Pipeline modules (00 to 17) that produce these outputs"),
])
```

Before version 10, the study was built as a **corpus** of twelve documents (two case definitions, two languages, combined manuscript, appendix and article) with 5 plates and 7 tables in the article and 54 plates and 125 supplementary tables, all produced by the modules `00_provenance.py` to `17_extended_material.py` of `study/pipeline/`. This page collects them so that no result is left out of the site: every plate is shown as a preview (the 600 dpi originals and the numeric tables are regenerated with the pipeline, which requires the GRD and REM microdata of the data volume) and every table unfolds from its presentation CSV (`docs/study/corpus/tables/`), with its title and its methodological note. The order and thematic groups are those of the module-17 index (`extended_material_index.md`). The results of version 10, reorganised around four panel figures, are in [version 10 results](version_10_panels.html); both come from the same tidy tables, and [the index](index.html#versions) records what each version of the series added.

The series on this page are those of the variant **without Rett syndrome** (F84 without F84.2), the case definition of the manuscript; the sensitivity with Rett appears in figure S1 of the corpus and in figure S8 of version 10. All counts are administrative recognition, not prevalence or incidence.

::: {.callout-note}
## Why this page shows stored images instead of the code that drew them

Unlike the [version 10 results](version_10_panels.html), where each figure is drawn by the code printed
with it, the plates below are stored images. The pipeline that produced them (`00_provenance.py` to
`17_extended_material.py`) reads the **GRD and REM microdata** of the data volume, which is not part of
this repository, so the drawing code cannot run here. What the repository does carry for these is the
pipeline code that produced them and the presentation CSV behind every table, which unfolds under each
one. The tables on this page are therefore data you can read; the plates are records.
:::

## Plates of the corpus article

```{python}
#| label: corpus-laminas-articulo
#| output: asis
for it in idx["article_figures"]:
    stem = it["file"].replace(".png", "")
    meta = rh.corpus_lookup(stem, caps["main"], caps["extra"], it["id"], it["desc"])
    print(rh.corpus_figure_md(stem, meta) + "\n")
```

## Supplementary plates of the corpus

```{python}
#| label: corpus-laminas-suplementarias
#| output: asis
group = None
for it in idx["figures"]:
    if it["group"] != group:
        group = it["group"]; print(f"\n### {group}\n")
    stem = it["file"].replace(".png", "")
    meta = rh.corpus_lookup(stem, caps["main"], caps["extra"], it["id"], it["desc"])
    print(f"**{it['id']}** (`{it['file']}`, origin: {it['origin']})\n")
    print(rh.corpus_figure_md(stem, meta) + "\n")
```

## Tables of the corpus article

```{python}
#| label: corpus-tablas-articulo
#| output: asis
for it in idx["article_tables"]:
    stem = it["file"].replace(".csv", "")
    meta = rh.corpus_lookup(stem, titles["main"], titles["extra"], it["id"], it["desc"])
    print(rh.corpus_table_html(stem, meta) + "\n")
```

## Supplementary tables of the corpus

```{python}
#| label: corpus-tablas-suplementarias
#| output: asis
group = None
for it in idx["tables"]:
    if it["group"] != group:
        group = it["group"]; print(f"\n### {group}\n")
    stem = it["file"].replace(".csv", "")
    meta = rh.corpus_lookup(stem, titles["main"], titles["extra"], it["id"], it["desc"])
    meta = dict(meta); meta["title"] = f"{it['id']}. " + meta["title"] if not meta["title"].startswith(it["id"]) else meta["title"]
    print(rh.corpus_table_html(stem, meta) + "\n")
```
